claims.assertion: Yazhi said a Federation underground base beneath Romania’s Carpathian Sphinx was about 5,000 years old and had been emptied by the Cabal in recent decades.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She said it contained maglev links and robotic guards.

claims.assertion: Yazhi said Tutankhamun’s dagger was made from material not found on Earth, while acknowledging she had no data about other removed objects.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi said magnetic spacecraft can collide if massive ships approach too closely, citing a 2016 Sirian–Taygetean collision.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

coverage_gaps: Crimean bases and spacecraft docking operations
